017package org.apache.juneau.http.header;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import java.util.*;
022import java.util.function.*;
023
024import org.apache.juneau.commons.http.*;
025
026
027/**
028 * Base type for headers whose wire format is an <c>Accept</c>-style list of media ranges.
029 *
030 * <p>
031 * <b>Beta — API subject to change:</b> This type is part of the next-generation REST client and HTTP stack.
032 * It is not API-frozen: binary- and source-incompatible changes may appear in the <b>next major</b> Juneau release
033 * (and possibly earlier).
034 *
035 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
036 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/NextGenRestClient">juneau-ng REST client</a>
037 * </ul>
038 *
039 * @since 9.2.1
040 */
041@SuppressWarnings({
042   "java:S2160", // equals() on HttpHeaderBean uses name + getValue(); typed state is reflected in getValue()
043   "unchecked" // Supplier<?> branches cast to typed suppliers after lazy-mode check
044})
045public class HttpMediaRangesHeader extends HttpHeaderBean {
046
047   /** Lazy supplier provides the wire string. */
048   public static final int LAZY_WIRE_STRING = 0;
049
050   /** Lazy supplier provides {@link MediaRanges} (re-evaluated on each access). */
051   public static final int LAZY_MEDIA_RANGES = 1;
052
053   private final MediaRanges cachedForStringOrDirect;
054   private final Supplier<?> lazySupplier;
055   private final int lazyMode;
056
057   /**
058    * @param name Header name. Must not be {@code null}.
059    * @param value Wire value. May be {@code null}.
060    */
061   protected HttpMediaRangesHeader(String name, String value) {
062      super(name, value);
063      this.cachedForStringOrDirect = value == null ? null : MediaRanges.of(value);
064      this.lazySupplier = null;
065      this.lazyMode = -1;
066   }
067
068   /**
069    * @param name Header name. Must not be {@code null}.
070    * @param value Parsed media ranges. May be {@code null}.
071    */
072   protected HttpMediaRangesHeader(String name, MediaRanges value) {
073      super(name, value == null ? null : value.toString());
074      this.cachedForStringOrDirect = value;
075      this.lazySupplier = null;
076      this.lazyMode = -1;
077   }
078
079   /**
080    * @param name Header name. Must not be {@code null}.
081    * @param supplier Lazy supplier; mode {@link #LAZY_WIRE_STRING} or {@link #LAZY_MEDIA_RANGES}. Must not be {@code null}.
082    * @param lazyMode Discriminator for erasure-safe lazy construction.
083    */
084   protected HttpMediaRangesHeader(String name, Supplier<?> supplier, int lazyMode) {
085      super(name, lazyMode == LAZY_WIRE_STRING
086         ? ((Supplier<String>) supplier)::get
087         : () -> {
088            var m = ((Supplier<MediaRanges>) supplier).get();
089            if (m == null)
090               return null;
091            return m.toString();
092         });
093      this.cachedForStringOrDirect = null;
094      this.lazySupplier = supplier;
095      this.lazyMode = lazyMode;
096   }
097
098   /**
099    * @return Parsed {@link MediaRanges}, or an empty {@link Optional} if the wire value is absent.
100    */
101   public Optional<MediaRanges> asMediaRanges() {
102      return o(toMediaRanges());
103   }
104
105   /**
106    * @param index Range index.
107    * @return The {@link MediaRange} at {@code index}, or {@code null} if out of range.
108    */
109   public MediaRange getRange(int index) {
110      var x = toMediaRanges();
111      return x == null ? null : x.getRange(index);
112   }
113
114   /**
115    * @param part Subtype fragment to find (e.g. {@code "activity"} for {@code text/json+activity}).
116    * @return {@code true} if any range's subtype contains the fragment.
117    */
118   public boolean hasSubtypePart(String part) {
119      var x = toMediaRanges();
120      return x != null && x.hasSubtypePart(part);
121   }
122
123   /**
124    * @param mediaTypes Candidate types, in preference order.
125    * @return Index of the best matching type, or {@code -1}.
126    */
127   public int match(List<? extends MediaType> mediaTypes) {
128      var x = toMediaRanges();
129      return x == null ? -1 : x.match(mediaTypes);
130   }
131
132   /**
133    * @param other Fallback when no parsed value is present.
134    * @return Parsed ranges or {@code other}.
135    */
136   public MediaRanges orElse(MediaRanges other) {
137      var x = toMediaRanges();
138      return nn(x) ? x : other;
139   }
140
141   /**
142    * @return Parsed {@link MediaRanges}, or {@code null} if the wire value is absent.
143    */
144   public MediaRanges toMediaRanges() {
145      if (lazyMode == LAZY_MEDIA_RANGES)
146         return ((Supplier<MediaRanges>) lazySupplier).get();
147      if (cachedForStringOrDirect != null)
148         return cachedForStringOrDirect;
149      var v = super.getValue();
150      return v == null ? null : MediaRanges.of(v);
151   }
152}
